rows.role_title: Deputy President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The NEC press statement dated Lusaka, 2 March 1990, reports an NEC meeting in Lusaka on 1 and 2 March 1990, attended by Nelson Mandela, Walter Sisulu and others; the NEC resolved that Mandela, Sisulu and Govan Mbeki resume their NEC places and 'further elected Comrade Nelson Mandela as Deputy President of the ANC'.

locator.section: Heading and dateline; first paragraph (meeting of 1 and 2 March 1990); paragraph on resuming NEC places and the Deputy President election

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The same statement says the NEC conveyed its warm greetings to 'Comrade President Oliver Tambo', thanked him for his contribution to its discussions, wished him a speedy recovery and was confident he would soon return to his post to lead the organisation.
